The '''R-28 starfighter''' was an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighter]] first designed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], though it was more commonly seen over a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later. For its size, the ship was relatively well armed, though half of its weapons were non-lethal, such as the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]].

==History==
At the time of the Galactic Civil War, the R-28 was overshadowed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] use of the wildly popular [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] during their fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and as a result production was postponed until long after the conflict came to an end. After the establishment of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] decades later, the early designs were eventually upgraded with modern technologies and engineering innovations. The R-28 served as an important intermediate step between the T-65 and the latest model of X-wing, the [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter]], which shared several of the same parts as the R-28.<ref name="LECG" />

Former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] used an R-28 to travel to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] at some point before the start of the Yuuzhan Vong War in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], where he was attacked by a [[Yuuzhan Vong|Vong]] advance force and crashed his fighter inside one of the invaders' [[Yuuzhan Vong advance scout ship|scout ships]].<ref name="SWL18">[[Legacy (2006) 18|''Legacy'' (2006) 18]]</ref>

The ship was still in production during the reign of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] in the year [[137 ABY]]. By this time, the R-28 had become a common craft used in local defense forces as well as by civilian pilots. Though outdated, the antique design remained one of the most common starfighters in the galaxy. Due to using the same parts, some R-28 factories would occasionally produce X-83s despite the latter ship being banned by the Empire.<ref name="LECG" />
